camel_example: aliyun live SetLiveStreamBlock --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --BlockType blacklist --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LocationList CN --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Sets stream-level blocking for live streams by calling SetLiveStreamBlock
description_zh: 调用SetLiveStreamBlock设置直播流粒度封禁
kebab_example: aliyun live set-live-stream-block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --block-type blacklist --location-list CN --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetLiveStreamBlock

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The blocking mode. Valid values:
blacklist: blacklist.
whitelist: whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 封禁方式，blacklist：黑名单，whitelist：白名单
parameters.name: block_type

parameters.help_en: The blocked regions, such as CN and AS. Separate multiple regions with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 封禁区域，如CN，AS多个以逗号隔开
parameters.name: location_list

parameters.help_en: The end time of the blocking period in UTC. If this parameter is not specified, the blocking lasts for 7 days by default
parameters.help_zh: 封禁结束时间，UTC格式，不填默认封禁7天
parameters.name: release_time

Description.description_en:
The result description.
Success: ok.
Failure: failure details

结果描述。
成功：ok。
失败：失败详情

ok: succeeded.
fail: failed.

ok：成功。
